translations.web: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
translations.bsb: A fool’s anger is known at once, but a prudent man overlooks an insult.
translations.kjv: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
translations.asv: A fool's vexation is presently known; But a prudent man concealeth shame.
